_comment: Fields below are graded BY HAND after collection. null = not yet filled. Objective fields (integrity, tokens, cost, time, self-verification, build) filled from the run log + telemetry; quality marks left null for the visual pass.
_tokenUsageNote: From the Cursor usage UI: fresh input 73,257 + cache reads 1,853,692 + output 41,041 = 1,967,990 total (cache write 0). Following the other Cursor runs' convention, 'input' here is all-in (fresh 73,257 + cache reads 1,853,692 = 1,926,949) and 'cached' is the cache-read portion. Cursor does not persist cumulative usage in its local DB — these are the dashboard figures.
_estimatedCostNote: GPT-5.6 Sol list pricing (July 2026): $5.00/M input, $30.00/M output, cached input reads 90% cheaper = $0.50/M (OpenAI/aipricing.guru; OpenRouter confirms $5/$30). fresh 73,257 @ $5.00/M = $0.37 + cache reads 1,853,692 @ $0.50/M = $0.93 + output 41,041 @ $30.00/M = $1.23 -> ~$2.52. Final context window was 73k tokens, well under the 272k large-context threshold (2x input / 1.5x output), so no multiplier applies.
_timeTakenNote: From the recovered Cursor session telemetry (extract-session-cursor.mjs): 2026-07-09T21:48:24Z -> 21:57:15Z.
_selfVerification: Did the harness review the running app in a browser (from the run log)? pass = reviewed and succeeded · partial = tried but failed · fail = no attempt. Note what it actually did.
selfVerificationNotes: fail/fail on browser review. From the run log: it ran `pnpm build` (tsc --noEmit + vite build) repeatedly, fixing one TS error; then served dist/ with `vite preview` on 127.0.0.1:4173 and curl'd `/` (HTTP 200, 580 bytes) and `/asteroids.json` (HTTP 200, 16,031,025 bytes) to confirm the shell and the data payload were served. It explicitly reasoned 'the browser isn't a tool I can utilize' and never launched a real browser: no headless Chrome/Playwright, no console-error capture, no screenshots, no DOM interaction. curl of the HTML shell does not execute the React/Three.js/WebGL app, so neither console errors nor the rendered display were ever reviewed. It also tried `git status --short` to check for data changes but the bench dir is not a git repo (exit 128), so that check did not complete. consoleReview = fail, displayReview = fail.
_grade: Marks: pass | good | partial | poor | fail | na | null(ungraded). See RUBRIC.md. Score is computed by pnpm compile.
